That table is the single home of every model pin outside Claude Code: when a host renames a model, it changes there and this file is regenerated. Never pin an id in prose.

**Claude Code is not in this file.** Its pins are canonical and live where they always have — each agent's own frontmatter and `<plugin root>/references/pipeline-mode.md`.

**Codex ids are PROPOSED** — owner sign-off pending. **OpenCode pins nothing**: agents and phases inherit the session model so local providers work, and tiering is opt-in by copying `<plugin root>/opencode/model-profile.cloud.example.json` (or `.local.`) into your own opencode.json.

## Tiers

| Tier | Cursor (start → escalate) | Codex (proposed) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `routine` — mechanical, predictable work | `composer` → `sonnet` | `gpt-5.6-luna` (medium reasoning) |
| `standard` — the default coding and review tier | `sonnet` → `gpt-5.5` | `gpt-5.6-terra` (medium reasoning) |
| `deep-review` — large or risky changes, hard reasoning | `gpt-5.5` → `opus` | `gpt-5.6-terra` (high reasoning) |
| `precision` — correctness-critical, security-sensitive work | `gpt-5.5` → `opus` | `gpt-5.6-sol` (xhigh reasoning) |

Cursor pins are the Domaine "Model Selection and Agentic Usage Guidelines" v1.0 scenario rows, in the least-versioned form the doc allows; the escalate column is the next rung of the ladder, taken after a failed attempt, never as a starting point.

## Ship-pipeline phases

Phase classes come from `<plugin root>/references/pipeline-mode.md`; the conductor passes the phase's model on every spawn.

| Phase class | Tier | Cursor | Codex (proposed) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| conductor — the ship session itself | `standard` | `sonnet` → `gpt-5.5` | `gpt-5.6-terra` (medium reasoning) |
| reasoning-heavy — implement, qa, the qa-loop and aftercare fix agents | `standard` | `sonnet` → `gpt-5.5` | `gpt-5.6-terra` (medium reasoning) |
| mechanical — finalize, create-pr, steps-to-test, the aftercare poll/triage agent | `routine` | `composer` → `sonnet` | `gpt-5.6-luna` (medium reasoning) |

- **conductor**: the strongest session model the host offers; on Cursor, Opus only at the guidelines' "exceptional" bar
- **reasoning-heavy**: escalate one tier for a phase that failed twice, per the guidelines' failure ladder
- **mechanical**: the aftercare fix agents are reasoning-heavy, not mechanical
